lines.text: The Teacher sees that wisdom exceeds folly as light exceeds darkness, since the wise man has eyes in his head.
The Teacher says the fate of the fool will also befall him, and both will be forgotten.
The Teacher hated all he had toiled for under the sun, because he must leave it to the man who comes after him.
The Teacher's heart began to despair over his labor, and even at night a man's hands do not rest.
Enjoying work comes from the hand of God, and to the sinner He assigns the task of guarding the gates.
